info.name: Box Authorize Authorization Collaboration Whitelist Entries API

params.name: marker
params.description:
Defines the position marker at which to begin returning results. This is
used when paginating using marker-based pagination.

This requires `usemarker` to be set to `true`.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

items.docs:
Returns the list domains that have been deemed safe to create collaborations
for within the current enterprise.

info.name: Box Add domain to list of allowed collaboration domains

items.docs:
Creates a new entry in the list of allowed domains to allow
collaboration for.

params.name: collaboration_whitelist_entry_id
params.description: The ID of the entry in the list.

items.docs:

info.name: Box Remove domain from list of allowed collaboration domains

params.name: collaboration_whitelist_entry_id
params.description: The ID of the entry in the list.

items.docs:
Removes a domain from the list of domains that have been deemed safe to create
